items.alt: Flashback: a laptop shows the livestream stuck on BUFFERING. Maya throws her hands up, wondering what she broke.

bubbles.text: Was that the switcher? The router? …me?

narration: Last week, the livestream froze mid-sermon.

items.alt: Ray points to a chart of the seven network layers, stacked like floors of a building: 1 physical at the bottom up to 7 application at the top.

bubbles.text: Seven floors, one building. Floor one is cable and light. Floor seven is the app people actually see.
So I can stop blaming myself at floor four.

items.text: FIELD NOTE —  Every network layer fails differently. Diagnosing floor by floor beats guessing at the whole building.
